problem_type: Dialog height and decision action ownership
symptom: Long settings and detail dialogs can scroll or clip the decision buttons in a minimum-size window.
direct_cause: Callers own viewport-height calculations and put footer actions inside the scroll region.
class_root: Remaining callers bypass the shared DesignModal height and action boundary.
affected_population: Minimum 1100x720 windows in Chinese and English
Long skill text and extraction template settings
internal_only_reason: Stage-one design approval already selected installed Mantine Modal and the shared DesignModal layout. This batch changes internal ownership only; no external API contract changes.
invariants: Only DesignModal owns dialog viewport height.
Decision actions live outside the scrollable body.
Settings delegated Escape and unsaved-change protection remain.

door_reduction.why_not: The original map had 14 DesignModal readers plus the MultiShot reader (15). Six old manual modal shells are deleted; their callers now share the existing owner. The generated after-map has 20 DesignModal readers plus MultiShotContractSummary and the main-process minimum-size reader (22). Distinct product entry points still need to open their own content; none owns a parallel modal shell.

generality_proof: Seven migrated consumers use the existing shared shell; decision footers are structurally outside the scrolling body. The same census measures the main-process minimum window in both languages. Nine full-screen editors/viewers remain their own layout boundary and are measured without converting their workspace into a modal.

recurrence.reason: Equivalent dialogs own independent height limits and footer placement. New languages and long content can reach the same mechanism.
same_class_scan: rg role=dialog, createPortal, fixed inset and viewport max heights across src; complete inventory in handoff report.

prevention.invariant: Migrated dialogs have a single height and action owner.
prevention.failure_mode: Long body scrolls while actions remain visible; geometry census fails on clipped actions.
prevention.strategy: Delete six manual dialog shells; keep all migrated decision footers in the existing actions slot.

legacy_paths.rationale: Delete manual settings/extraction Portal, scrim and viewport-height ownership; skill detail no longer owns footer/viewport height; multishot no longer owns nested scrolling.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Mantine Modal with a native fixed footer slot if a supported version provides one
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse the installed Modal max-height, focus and portal handling; no dependency addition.
exit_criteria: Replace the shell footer wiring only when a supported native footer meets the same geometry and action-ownership tests.

migration: No stored data changes. Existing settings and skill handlers remain; old shells are deleted in the migration commit.
residual_risks: Nine full-screen viewers/workspaces are explicitly not DesignModal migrations; record their actual minimum-window control measurements separately.
Linux and Windows runtime screenshots are unverified.
No paid generation is run; amount, selection and paid callbacks are unchanged.

New lab states lack CI macOS visual baselines. Independent acceptance and escape-ledger linking are assigned to coordination after PR creation; this implementation line does not invent either receipt.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The shell owns layout; consumer structural tests prevent moving actions back into the scroll area.
